summary: Find the single solid cyan 8 rectangle. For each row in its height, paint a yellow 4 beam from the far edge of the nearest same-row-band blocker on the left to the far edge of the nearest blocker on the right, using grid edges when absent. Do the analogous operation vertically for every cyan column, then restore cyan and every non-red/non-cyan blocker. Red 2 rectangles are transparent and remain overwritten wherever a beam crosses them.
